# v0.10.2 · 暗标检查与生成流程改进 / Blind Bid Checks and Generation Improvements

## 中文

### 暗标检查

- 集成暗标检查的预设配置、DOCX 检查、结果复核、修复与导出流程，并分别适配守矩和启象界面。
- 优化检查向导的布局、深色主题、勾选控件、检查方式选择和运行进度提示。
- AI 复核失败时保留程序检查结果，并清晰说明失败状态，避免将失败误认为检查通过。

### 技术方案与废标项检查

- 优化技术方案目录生成、排序与确认交互，保留自由模式下的多级目录能力；处理输入材料不足时的继续方式。
- 修正目录编辑后的正文与缓存同步，并完善后台任务状态处理。
- 改进废标项逻辑问题的复核与导出：已确认无误的条目不再作为问题导出，调整部分难以理解的建议话术。

### 客户端体验

- 每次启动时静默检查新版本；发现更新后在右上角提醒，可选择“立刻更新”进入手动更新弹窗，或“稍后更新”关闭提醒。
- 调整更新弹窗的下载安装状态和安装包提示，并改善部分页面及导出按钮的排版与可读性。

## English

### Blind bid checks

- Integrated presets, DOCX inspection, result review, fixes, and export, with layouts for both Classic and Modern interfaces.
- Improved the check wizard layout, dark theme, controls, check mode selection, and progress feedback.
- Kept programmatic findings available when AI review fails and made the failure state explicit.

### Technical plans and rejection checks

- Improved outline generation, ordering, and confirmation while retaining multilevel outlines in free mode; added clearer handling for incomplete source materials.
- Kept body content and caches in sync after outline edits and improved background task state handling.
- Refined review and export of logical findings so confirmed valid entries are omitted from issue exports, and clarified several recommendations.

### Client experience

- Added a silent version check on each launch. A new release triggers an upper-right reminder with options to open the manual update dialog or dismiss the reminder.
- Improved download and installer status in the update dialog, plus layout and readability in several screens and export controls.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liwg1995/YuduBid/compare/v0.10.1...v0.10.2
